Tabulate ACE catch by year and a grouping variable

table_ace.Rd

Takes the output of get_ace(), aggregates total catch (t) by YY and a chosen grouping column, then pivots the grouping column out wide so each year is a row and each group (species, gear, ocean, flag, etc.) is a column. Where pivot_by is GEAR_CODE or SP_CODE, column names use full names rather than raw codes.

Usage

table_ace(
  data,
  pivot_by,
  totals = TRUE,
  round_to = 1,
  abbreviate_flags = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

A tibble as returned by get_ace(), containing at least YY and sum_catch_mt.

pivot_by

Bare column name to pivot wide (e.g. SP_CODE, GEAR_CODE, OCEAN_CODE, FLAG_CODE).

totals

Logical. Add a Total row and column? Defaults to TRUE.

round_to

Numeric. Round catch values to the nearest this many units before display. Defaults to 1.

abbreviate_flags

Logical. If pivot_by is FLAG_CODE, should column names use abbreviated country names (e.g. "FSM") rather than full names? Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A tibble, one row per YY, one column per level of pivot_by (plus Total if totals = TRUE).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ace_output <- get_ace(ocean = "WX", species = c("YFT", "SKJ"))

table_ace(ace_output, pivot_by = SP_CODE)
table_ace(ace_output, pivot_by = GEAR_CODE, totals = FALSE)
} # }
